name: FAIRE
provenance: Hand-maintained: no repo script regenerates this file. Written on 2026-10-19 from $HBM_EXTERNAL_ROOT/faire/MANIFEST.json, the acquirer's full manifest (outside git). bytes and sha256 were measured on the verified raw files and equal that manifest wherever it lists the same file; extracted members were also checked against the archive they come from. A tree_sha256 is scripts/fetch_external_data.py::tree_digest of the directory.
notes: Staging reads kaggle_resume's Resume.csv to tie each FAIRE base CV to its Kaggle ID (depends_on). The notebook Resume_Bias_Test.ipynb is not needed and is never run.
